name: American Water Works
description: American Water is the largest publicly traded US water and wastewater utility, serving about 14 million people in 24 states. Its regulated utilities (92 percent of 2025 revenue, $4.7B) operate in 14 states with 3.6 million customers; they hold local monopolies and state commissions set rates that let them earn a return on the pipes and plants they build, so profit growth is driven by capital spending ($3.1B in 2025) and rate cases. The rest is the Military Services Group, which runs water and wastewater systems on 18 military bases under 50-year US government contracts, plus small other businesses; the Homeowner Services Group has been sold. Pennsylvania is the biggest state at 24 percent of regulated revenue. On October 26, 2025 the company agreed to merge with Essential Utilities in an all-stock deal, pending approvals.
